text: A spring has spring constant k. The natural length of the spring is 7 feet long. The work done in compressing it from 5 feet long to 3 feet long is 84 foot-pounds. The work done to compress it from 7 feet long to 3 feet long can be expressed as an integral of the form f: f(z)de. (a) What is the lower limit of integration, a? (b) What is the upper limit of integration, b? (c) What is the value of the spring constant, k? (d) What is the integrand, f(z)? (e) What are the units of work for the integral?
